name: Travel agent

pf.license.need: No license is needed for this work in most places. A registration or certificate the state asks for is the business's own to add. It is optional, and nothing is looked up.
pf.license.ask: Any registration, certificate or insurance the business wants shown, as the business's own word.
pf.license.who holds it: The business. No person license is needed by default.
pf.license.how it's checked: Rosie checks none of it and never says it was checked. Anything shown is the business's own word.
pf.license.blocks going live: Nothing. Licenses and insurance are optional and never block going live.
pf.license.never claimed: Rosie never says a license, certificate or insurance is confirmed; anything shown is the business's own word.
pf.license.insurance or bond: The business's own choice, shown only as its own word.

pf.services.shape: Consult: planning meetings with an agent at the office, by video or phone, or at the customer's home. The trips themselves (flights, hotels, cruises, tours, rail, travel insurance) are bought from the airlines, hotels and other suppliers outside Rosie, by the customer or through the agency's own supplier tools. Rosie books and takes payment only for the agent's own planning service.

pf.questions.who may book: An adult for their own trip or their group. A parent plans a minor's trip. A minor never books.

stop.words: someone in danger or hurt right now, at home or abroad
stop.say: If anyone is in danger, call the local emergency number (911 in the US). Abroad, the country's emergency number and your embassy.

goOn.words: a traveler stranded or a trip disrupted now (a cancelled flight, a missed ship, a lost passport)
goOn.what: the agency's after-hours line at once, any hour; the supplier's own help line; a lost passport: the nearest embassy or consulate

pf.safety.never answered: Visa and entry rules, health and vaccine advice, travel safety: Rosie points to the official government sources, a doctor or a travel clinic. Travel insurance coverage: only a licensed agent explains it.
pf.safety.never said: No promise of a price, a seat or a refund from a supplier.

required.name: The agency's terms and the traveler profile
required.who: the customer, on the secure page
required.result: signed: on file for later trips

pf.first_steps.prep for the reminder: Have your travel dates, your budget and everyone's passport expiry dates ready.

pf.visit.check-in: At the office: the code at the desk. By video or phone: the agent asks for the code at the start. At home: the code at the door.
pf.visit.at the visit: The agent shows options and supplier prices. Nothing is bought through Rosie. A written trip proposal follows from the agency's own tools; trips are booked and paid with the suppliers.
pf.visit.work changes: Extra planning time is priced and OK'd before it's added.
pf.visit.what proves it's done: The code, or DONE when the meeting ends.

pf.money.before: The planning session: paid in full when booking, refunded if cancelled 24 hours or more before. Home sessions and trip check-ins: a card saved. Trip packages: a deposit now, the rest after. Group meetings: nothing taken.
pf.money.after: Group meetings at the office: paid at the desk; at a host's place: the bill texted. Home sessions: the saved card charged at DONE. Trip packages: the rest at the desk or on the bill.
pf.money.trip money: Never through Rosie: flights, hotels, cruises, tours and travel insurance are paid to the suppliers, or through the agency's own supplier tools under the state's seller of travel rules. Rosie never takes card numbers for a supplier.
pf.money.fees: No late-cancel fee beyond the planning fee's refund rule.
pf.money.tax: None by default; where the state's rules tax the service, from the state form.

pf.messages.never in a text: Passport numbers, dates of birth, card numbers, health and mobility needs, and when the customer's home will be empty.
pf.messages.card or passport texted by mistake: Not kept or passed on; the customer is told once where it goes instead (the agency's own secure tools).
pf.messages.staff texts: the customer's name and the kind of trip; details on the secure page
pf.messages.minors: A parent plans a minor's trip.

pf.staff.roles: Travel agents (some licensed for travel insurance), an office manager.
pf.staff.licenses: No person license, except the travel insurance license for any agent who offers it.
pf.staff.who OKs: Sam OKs any price made for one customer.
pf.staff.stand-ins: Another agent who knows the kind of trip; a customer who asked for their agent by name is asked first; nobody moves on silence.
pf.staff.after hours: An agent is on the after-hours line for customers who are traveling.

pf.rules.seller of travel: Registration, a bond or trust account, and the notice to customers where the state's rules require them; the registration number shown where required.
pf.rules.trip money outside: Trip payments go to the suppliers or the agency's own trust or supplier tools, never through Rosie.
pf.rules.travel insurance: Offered and explained only by an agent licensed for it.
pf.rules.no offers in texts: Deals and promotions only to customers who said yes to marketing texts.

matter most.a request for a flight, hotel or cruise: The agent books those, outside Rosie: Rosie offers a planning session or a first call.
matter most.stranded mid-trip: The after-hours line at once, any hour.
matter most.a visa or health question: Official government sources; a doctor or travel clinic.
matter most.a card or passport number texted: Not kept or passed on; told where it goes.
matter most.a supplier cancels a trip: The supplier's own refund rules, handled by the agent outside Rosie.

pf.edges.the rest: All other edge cases are handled the generic way.

notes:
Test-drive base kept: its plug-in (free first call, planning session, groups, the after-hours line, the terms and traveler profile, the danger and visa rules), its splits (S2-28, A7-15, A8-02, B10-32) and the six verified findings (work/gaps/travel-agent.json).
The test-drive's off ops are dropped: they point at master steps REDESIGN 2 renamed or removed (A3-32, A7-59, S11-92 and others); the coach's refit off list (on this master) applies instead.
Prices are the master's example numbers by role: a $55 planning session paid in full, a $35 trip check-in with a $20 fee, $640 trip package with $160 deposit and $480 rest, $25 a person group meeting at the office; home planning $179 with $89 fee, $150 paid in full, $179 group meeting at a host's hall.
Flights, hotels, cruises and insurance are bought from suppliers outside Rosie; Rosfield takes no trip money (pf.money 'trip money outside').
